entities.summary: Jarvis Lamar Varnado is an American former professional basketball player who played for two seasons in the National Basketball Association (NBA), for the Boston Celtics, Miami Heat, Chicago Bulls, and Philadelphia 76ers. Varnado was known as a defensive specialist and was especially adept at shot blocking, aided by his large wingspan.
